{{NPC Infobox |image = NPC The Recorder Laetia.png |type = Quest |type2 = Resonator |realname = Laetia |nation = Lahai-Roi |location = Bjartr Woods |location2 = Startorch Academy - Square |affiliation = Roya Tribe |affiliation2 = Heliodic Six |status = Alive
No longer able to read the Heliosgyre after her mind was corrupted by Voidmatter, she serves the Solisylum by collecting data from the outside world now. |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} {{Quote|Not a single speck of dust lies upon her robes.}} '''The Recorder''' is one of the [[Heliodic Six]] members and makes her first appearance in [[Ode to the Second Sunrise]]. After completing {{Quest|Ode to the Second Sunrise}}, The Recorder is freed from her duties and can be found at [[Spacetrek Archive]] at the Freight Zone level at {{color|help|06:00 to 17:00.}} She speaks in third person and refers to [["The Shaper"|The Shaper]] by name rather than title. ==Location== Heliodic Six Location - The Recorder.png ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} {{Dialogue Start}} ==Dialogue== :;Rinascita... the Carnevale... Gondolas... Gladiator battles... :'''The Recorder:''' Laetia has finished reading the history of Rinascita. Next, a book about Huanglong she will read. :{{DIcon}} Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six? :'''The Recorder:''' Yes. The Recorder is Laetia's other name. :{{DIcon}} What brings you here? :'''The Recorder:''' {{Rubi|Isander|The Shaper}} remains in the Solisylum, computing the sun's properties. So Laetia has come here, to compute the properties of humankind. :'''The Recorder:''' {{Rubi|Isander|The Shaper}} wishes to know how people from different places mark time, how they celebrate festivities... This knowledge extends beyond Lahai-Roi, and thus beyond Isander's ken. :'''The Recorder:''' Therefore, Laetia the Recorder is here to read the world and record what she sees. To Isander, she will carry these stories. :'''The Recorder:''' That way, alone with the Heliogyre he will not be. What Laetia sees, he too shall see. {{Dialogue End}} ==Character Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages| |en = The Recorder |zhs = 镌律 |zht = 鐫律 |ja = 記す者 |ko = 전률(the Recorder) |fr = L'Archiviste |de = Der Aufzeichner |es = La Grabadora |th = ผู้จารึกกฎ }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.0}}
